piezas.titulo: Written production: Health and everyday symptoms
texto: Guided writing on health and rest: write a note telling a teacher or colleague that you are unwell. Structures: «วันนี้ฉันไม่สบาย ปวดหัวและมีไข้ค่ะ» (Today I'm not well; I have a headache and a fever) and «ต้องกินยาและพักผ่อน» (I have to take medicine and rest).

opciones.texto: Eating well-cooked food prevents gastrointestinal food poisoning.

opciones.texto: An annual health check allows risks to be detected at an early stage.
